content.text: {"notes":["All requested readouts are at absolute simulation time t = 1.0 s in the world frame; positions are in meters and orientations are dimensionless quaternions.","The world frame is right-handed with +x forward, +y left, and +z up; quaternion components are ordered (x, y, z, w).","A 1.855228111940282 N force in the world +x direction is scheduled on block_1 at its instantaneous center of mass over [0.434, 0.534) s; the controller is evaluated every 0.002 s.","The left_table flag means block_2's center of mass is outside the table footprint [-2,2] × [-2,2]; support_lost means the initially stacked upper block lost supporting contact after the observation cutoff."]}
